requirements.title: Define security requirements for the pipeline
requirements.description: Security requirements for the CI/CD pipeline should be defined and documented. This includes requirements for authentication, authorization, encryption, and logging.

requirements.title: Define pipeline architecture
requirements.description: The architecture of the CI/CD pipeline should be defined and documented. This includes the components, their interactions, and the data flows.

requirements.title: Define pipeline security controls
requirements.description: Security controls for the CI/CD pipeline should be defined and documented. This includes controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, and logging.

requirements.title: Define code review requirements
requirements.description: Requirements for code reviews should be defined and documented. This includes requirements for who performs the reviews, what is reviewed, and how the reviews are documented.

requirements.title: Define testing requirements
requirements.description: Requirements for testing should be defined and documented. This includes requirements for unit tests, integration tests, and security tests.

requirements.title: Implement secure coding standards
requirements.description: Secure coding standards should be implemented and enforced. This includes standards for input validation, output encoding, authentication, and authorization.

requirements.title: Implement static analysis
requirements.description: Static analysis tools should be implemented to detect security vulnerabilities in the code. This includes tools for detecting SQL injection, XSS, and other common vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Implement dynamic analysis
requirements.description: Dynamic analysis tools should be implemented to detect security vulnerabilities in running applications. This includes tools for detecting SQL injection, XSS, and other common vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Implement dependency scanning
requirements.description: Dependency scanning tools should be implemented to detect vulnerable dependencies. This includes tools for detecting outdated libraries, known vulnerabilities, and license issues.

requirements.title: Update dependencies
requirements.description: Dependencies should be updated to the latest versions to fix known vulnerabilities. This includes updating libraries, frameworks, and other dependencies.

requirements.title: Implement build verification
requirements.description: Build verification should be implemented to ensure that builds are consistent and reproducible. This includes verifying that the build process produces the expected output.

requirements.title: Sign build artifacts
requirements.description: Build artifacts should be signed to ensure their integrity. This includes signing executables, libraries, and other artifacts.

requirements.title: Verify build artifacts
requirements.description: Build artifacts should be verified to ensure their integrity. This includes verifying signatures, checksums, and other integrity checks.

requirements.title: Implement release verification
requirements.description: Release verification should be implemented to ensure that releases are consistent and reproducible. This includes verifying that the release process produces the expected output.

requirements.title: Sign release artifacts
requirements.description: Release artifacts should be signed to ensure their integrity. This includes signing executables, libraries, and other artifacts.

requirements.title: Verify release artifacts
requirements.description: Release artifacts should be verified to ensure their integrity. This includes verifying signatures, checksums, and other integrity checks.

requirements.title: Implement deployment verification
requirements.description: Deployment verification should be implemented to ensure that deployments are consistent and reproducible. This includes verifying that the deployment process produces the expected output.

requirements.title: Monitor deployments
requirements.description: Deployments should be monitored to detect anomalies and security issues. This includes monitoring for unauthorized deployments, failed deployments, and other issues.

requirements.title: Roll back deployments
requirements.description: Deployments should be able to be rolled back to a previous version in case of issues. This includes having a rollback plan and testing the rollback process.
